title: Wed 30 Sep 2026: Long yields at 24-year highs, BoE pauses gilt sales, FCA crypto gateway opens, fund M&A wave
summary: Wall Street slips for a second day as the 30-year Treasury yield hits its highest since 2002 and US consumer confidence falls to a 12-year low; the Bank of England is reported to pause gilt sales ahead of the 28 October budget. Regulation: the FCA cryptoasset application window opens, the UK AIFM regime consultation runs to 22 October, and Ombudsman changes start on 1 October. Funds: T. Rowe Price, Victory Capital and Vanguard deals point to a consolidation wave, plus three COO action points.
